topics.name: Autoencoders
topics.description: A type of artificial neural network used for unsupervised learning tasks.

sub_topics.name: Denoising Autoencoders
sub_topics.description: Autoencoders designed to remove noise from input data.

sub_topics.name: Contractive Autoencoders
sub_topics.description: Autoencoders that enforce a contractive penalty on the learned representation.

sub_topics.name: Sparse Autoencoders
sub_topics.description: Autoencoders that impose sparsity constraints on the hidden layer.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of neural networks and linear algebra.
common_misconceptions: Autoencoders are only for image data.
They can only be used for dimensionality reduction.

topics.name: Manifold Learning
topics.description: A set of techniques for learning low-dimensional representations of high-dimensional data.

sub_topics.name: Tangent Hyperplane
sub_topics.description: A linear approximation of a manifold at a given point.

sub_topics.name: Manifold Representation
sub_topics.description: The representation of data points in a lower-dimensional manifold.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra and statistics.
common_misconceptions: Manifold learning is only for image data.

topics.name: Learning Algorithms
topics.description: Methods and techniques used to train models in machine learning.

sub_topics.name: Stochastic Autoencoders
sub_topics.description: Autoencoders that incorporate stochastic elements in their architecture.

sub_topics.name: Score Matching
sub_topics.description: A technique for estimating the parameters of probabilistic models.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and programming.
common_misconceptions: All algorithms work equally well for every problem.
More data always leads to better models.

topics.name: Neural Network Components
topics.description: Key elements that make up neural networks and their functionality.

sub_topics.name: Decoder
sub_topics.description: The part of an autoencoder that reconstructs the input from the encoded representation.

sub_topics.name: Activation Function
sub_topics.description: Functions that determine the output of a neuron given an input.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra and calculus.
common_misconceptions: More layers always mean better performance

topics.name: Training Techniques
topics.description: Methods used to optimize the performance of machine learning models.

sub_topics.name: Backpropagation
sub_topics.description: An algorithm for training neural networks by minimizing the loss function.

sub_topics.name: Loss Function
sub_topics.description: A function that quantifies the difference between predicted and actual outcomes.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
common_misconceptions: More data always leads to better models
Training and testing data can be mixed

topics.name: Data Reconstruction
topics.description: The process of reconstructing original data from its compressed representation.

sub_topics.name: Input Reconstruction
sub_topics.description: The task of reconstructing the original input from the encoded representation.

sub_topics.name: Reconstructed Input
sub_topics.description: The output generated by the decoder in an autoencoder.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of data representation and compression techniques.
common_misconceptions: Data reconstruction is only applicable to images

topics.name: Autoencoder Variants
topics.description: Different types of autoencoders designed for specific tasks.

sub_topics.name: Overcomplete Autoencoders
sub_topics.description: Autoencoders with more hidden units than input dimensions.

sub_topics.name: Undercomplete Autoencoders
sub_topics.description: Autoencoders with fewer hidden units than input dimensions.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of neural networks and unsupervised learning.
common_misconceptions: Autoencoders can only be used for dimensionality reduction

topics.name: Coordinate Systems
topics.description: Frameworks for representing data points in a multi-dimensional space.

sub_topics.name: Global Coordinate
sub_topics.description: A coordinate system that encompasses the entire data space.

sub_topics.name: Euclidean Coordinate
sub_topics.description: A standard coordinate system based on Euclidean geometry.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of algebra and geometry.
common_misconceptions: All coordinate systems are the same

topics.name: Model Evaluation
topics.description: Techniques for assessing the performance of machine learning models.

sub_topics.name: Classification Accuracy
sub_topics.description: A metric that measures the proportion of correct predictions.

sub_topics.name: Likelihood Score
sub_topics.description: A measure of how well a model explains the observed data.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and statistics.
common_misconceptions: Accuracy is the only metric that matters.
Overfitting is not a concern if the model performs well on training data.
